Marta V.: Quick check for 'Mini Demo Day' (May 20). Reg page live? consent language ready? Zoom cloud + RTMP fallback? S3 naming + clip owners? HubSpot mapping? Post-event timeline & owners?
Noah B.: Ill finalize reg copy and add GDPR/CCPA consent checkbox. Will include a short opt-out for marketing use of recordings. ETA 2pm today.
Sam Lee: HubSpot mapping: add hidden fields utm_campaign, demo_cohort, region_code. Import sets lifecycle = "lead" and property source = "mini_demo_may2026". Will supply CSV template.
Priya K.: Zoom ops recs: host = Marta, co-host = Noah. Cloud recording ON (active speaker), enable SRT captions. Also enable local recording as fallback. RTMP fallback URL: rtmp://backup.streams.redwood/mini-demo-2026. Waiting room until -3m then open.
Evan R.: S3 ingest prefix for editors: /events/mini-demo/2026-05-20/raw/. Clip naming convention: mini-demo_2026-05-20__{speakerShort}__{segmentLabel}_v{rev}.mp4. I'll run RTMP route test tomorrow 9am PT.
Marta V.: Post-event timeline: auto-transcript + whisper JSON in ~36h, highlight pack (3 clips ~90s each) in 48h, full edit + timestamps in 7 days. Owners: Noah = clip exports & highlights, Priya = HubSpot import & SDR tagging, Evan = ingest monitoring & S3 uploads.
Noah B.: Confirm I own draft clips and highlight edits (48h). Ill upload to s3://redwood-events/mini-demo/2026-05-20/ and post the clip sheet with timestamps and suggested social copy. :white_check_mark: 
Priya K.: After Noah uploads, Ill import registrants and run enrichment job. SDR outreach window = 48-72h after highlights publish. Rule: if watch_pct >= 50% OR clicked_demo_cta -> set lifecycle = "sales_contact" and assign SDR.
webinar-bot: Reminder: "Mini Demo Day" scheduled 2026-05-20T17:00:00Z. Cloud recording & SRT captions enabled.
Marta V.: Great. Final asks: Noah confirm S3 path after test upload; Evan confirm RTMP test tomorrow. If green, Ill publish the Notion runbook and pin to channel. :rocket:
